name: Flaky Monitor Report Persistence

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  flaky-monitor:
    if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Run flaky monitor
        run: |
          # Run your flaky monitoring script here
          # Example: cargo test --lib -- --nocapture
          echo "Running flaky monitor..."
          
      - name: Upload flaky report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: |
            flaky-report.json
            flaky-report.txt
          retention-days: 30

  persist-reports:
    needs: flaky-monitor
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download flaky report
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: ./reports

      - name: Store persistent report
        run: |
          # Create a persistent storage location for reports
          mkdir -p ./persistent-reports
          cp ./reports/* ./persistent-reports/
          
      - name: Commit and push reports
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add ./persistent-reports/
          git commit -m "Update flaky reports" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/flaky-reports || echo "Failed to push reports"
